title: The Rhino Wallow
text: A mud wallow steams in the heat, and a rhino sleeps in it, snoring like distant thunder, flies crawling on its hide. The only path runs right past its horn. Its small eye is shut. Mostly shut.

options.label: Tiptoe past the horn, and pray the snoring does not stop.

outcomes.text: It snores on. You come out mud to the knee, and the mud dries on your greaves hard as stone.

options.label: The quickest leads, setting a pace fast enough to be past before it stirs.

outcomes.text: Past before it stirs, and only the flies notice.

options.label: Roll in the mud to hide your scent from everything that hunts by smell.

outcomes.text: Filthy, and stinking, and unseen by anything for a day.
